title: Missing moeb tool: Read (fix_signal result file)
description: The fix_signal MCP tool returns a rendered prompt that exceeds the MCP inline response limit. The kernel saves the output to a host-absolute temp file path that moeb tools cannot access (read_file uses project-relative paths only). The external Claude Code Read tool was required to read the fix_signal workflow content before the skill phases could begin.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a result_reader tool that accepts the kernel-reported temp file path and returns its content, or extend fix_signal to chunk its output into multiple smaller tool results.
